what: Study 4 development and fix-check effects: hit counts and hits per 1,000 words by module, category or K-band, and register, for 0.3.2, 0.3.3 and 0.4.0 on the development texts and for 0.3.3 and each round's candidate on the fix-check texts; plus the registered gate results copied from the public acceptance files.
caveat: Development diagnostics: output counts, not precision and not recall; development-text changes are not an unbiased before/after estimate. Gate results are copied, not recomputed.

method.word_count: len(text.split()) on the archived (normalised, possibly truncated) text: the whitespace rule build.py uses for eligibility and fixcheck/crosswalk.py uses for density
method.groups: metadiscourse: hit category; phrase: K-band of the matched PHRASE List entry
method.pct_change: round(100 * (after - before) / before, 1); null when before is 0
method.development_0.3.3: fix-check harness dry run (.cache/validation/study4_fix040/harness_dryrun), BASELINE frame, pinned dec79bc checkout run in its own uv environment, no families; equal hit for hit to BASELINE_PINNED and to hits_033.jsonl
method.rounds: density recomputed from private run/frames/<config>.hits.jsonl and the round's collect/texts; equal cell for cell to the archived private diff/frames.json density
method.key_comparison: multiset per (module, text_id, span) of claims (category; or PHRASE expression, rank, sense); not the fix-check crosswalk

per_family_totals_from_narrowing_check.note: each kept family switched on alone over 0.3.3 on the development texts; all registers

gates.decision_wording: failed: a deterministic breach certificate holds; the checked candidate cannot be kept
passed the loss safeguards (not 'all fixes validated')
